name: When should I consider replacing or upgrading my exterior window trim?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing or upgrading my exterior window trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing or upgrading your exterior window trim if you notice signs of rot, cracking, peeling paint, or gaps that could allow moisture intrusion. Deteriorated trim compromises your home's protection and curb appeal. Additionally, if you're undertaking exterior renovations or simply want to update your home's aesthetic, upgrading the trim can provide a significant visual impact. Our team can help you assess the condition of your current trim and recommend whether replacement or repair is the most effective solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing trim if you see rot, cracks, peeling paint, or gaps. It's also a good idea during exterior renovations to boost curb appeal and protection.
